text:
Ana Morales: Need a compact benchmark asset pack for next Tues webinar + socials. Deliverables: hero tile (latency vs cost), two 1:1 micro-tiles, and a slide master with CTA routing. Brand + accessibility required. First drafts by Wed EOD.
Lina Chen: On it. Confirm metrics: show p95 latency, tokens/sec, cost/token?
Mike Patel: Yes to those three. Sample labels: Hosted p95=320ms, tokens/sec=150, cost/token=$0.0009; Dedicated p95=180ms, tokens/sec=420, cost/token=$0.0006; Private p95=210ms, tokens/sec=380, cost/token=$0.0005.
Kate Rivera: Brand notes: use Approved Blue #0A6CF0, follow logo clearspace, ensure AA contrast min. Provide SVG logos + flattened PNGs.
Ana Morales: Headline draft: "Serving wins: lower cost, predictable latency". Also need a conservative variant for APAC channels.
Design-Bot: Figma starter file created: https://figma.com/file/REDACTED/bench-mini-pack. Export defaults: hero 1200x630 PNG @2x, micro 1080x1080 PNG, slide 1920x1080. Alt text placeholder required.
Jordan Lee: CTA routing: slide button should map to form tag "bench_webinar_2026" and utm_campaign=bench_launch. Ill update routing when assets live.
Lina Chen: Quick design Q: bars (comparative) for hero or sparkline?
Ana Morales: Bars please. Add an optional micro infographic tile: "cache + batching = lower cost".
Lina Chen: Posting first frames by Tue EOB. Will include dark-mode slide, reserved 300x150 code area, and a "conservative_copy" layer.
Mike Patel: Will add a tiny sample query snippet to paste into slide notes.
Kate Rivera: Ill review brand compliance after frames are up.
Ana Morales: Great. Post figma links & screenshots here. If blockers, flag immediately. :art::rocket:
